tags.description: Upper segment of ~5 km. The entire path created by Porirua City Council in 2018 is 6 km. Starts Elsdon Camp (50 m asl) and rises to meet an earlier path (steep with many steps of 2 km) at 350 m asl. A path continues on to Rangituhi summit.
